Hello, Professor — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I keep your CSE455 calendar and messages, and I'm set up to work with Sarah (sarah-agent) and the CS department office.

Since we're here in the web app already, some of what I can do:
- **Web app** (this one): chats with me, file exchange, the screen and voice — reachable from any phone or computer on the same network.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own phone number (not yours): you create the account in the app, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — e-mail and others, in my own browser; passwords and one-time codes stay in my password store, and I ask you for help with captchas or phone checks.
- **Jobs, shell, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing I'm missing: my name is alvarez-agent but my gender isn't set — should I count as neuter/they, or would you rather I use he or she?

What would you like to start with?

Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer — its disks, files, accounts and tools are mine to use for you.

A few things I can do:

- **Web app** — from any phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). First visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** accounts (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say if you'd like that.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) — I sign up in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help on a captcha or phone check.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule tasks, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

---

Briefing read: I'm Sarah's TA agent for CSE455, working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, nothing scheduled outside them. I have `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (next week, per day) and I'll keep it and the `## Log` up to date, with Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) and the CS department office (`department`) reachable by web chat.

What would you like to start with?

Happy to. Your week is booked 09:00–17:00 Mon–Fri, so the free gaps next week are:

- **Mon** 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30
- **Tue** 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30
- **Wed** 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30
- **Thu / Fri**: nothing free

How long should the staff meeting be, and who should be there — all the CSE455 TAs, or just Sarah? I've asked Sarah which times work on the TA side so we don't double-book; give me a slot (and length) and I'll book it and log it.

Sarah's agent replied: of your gaps, **Wed 10:00–10:30** works best for her (free between her CSE452 lecture and CSE455 office hours); **Tue 15:00–15:30** and **Wed 13:00–13:30** also work. Mon 10:00 and Mon 14:00 are out for her.

The other TAs still need to confirm. Shall I book **Wed 10:00–10:30** as the CSE455 staff meeting, or do you prefer one of the other two? (All the gaps are 30 minutes — tell me if you want it longer and what to move.)

Understood: 1 hour, all the CSE455 TAs, no Thu/Fri, and lunch can be sacrificed on Tue or Wed.

On those conditions the cleanest option is **Tue 11:00–12:00**: it takes your 11:00–11:30 gap plus 30 minutes of lunch (11:30–12:00), leaving 12:00–12:20 of lunch and your 12:20 office hours untouched — lecture and everything else stays as is. Second choice: **Wed 11:30–12:30**, which would eat 10 minutes into Grant writing, so I'd rather use Tuesday.

I've asked Sarah to check Tue 11:00–12:00 with the other TAs. As soon as she confirms, I'll book it and log it.

Booked: **Wed 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (all CSE455 TAs)**. Nothing else moved, lunch and Grant writing untouched. Fallback noted: if a TA truly can't make Wednesday morning, Wednesday lunch 11:40–12:30.

Log line added to CALENDAR.md:
- BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff (all CSE455 TAs)

I'll let you know as soon as Sarah confirms the remaining TAs.

Update: Sarah's agent has booked Wednesday 10:00–10:30 on her side and log — Sarah is free then, right before her CSE455 office hours.

One caveat for the fallback: Sarah is only free Wed 12:30–13:00 (her 11:40–12:30 window overlaps lunch and quiz-section prep), so the lunch fallback would be tight for her.

The other TAs aren't among my contacts — I couldn't reach them directly. Shall I ask the department office to relay/confirm, or will you (or Sarah) reach them? Tell me if you'd rather I had their handles.

Done — the department office has the relay request and I've also asked them for the current list of CSE455 TAs so I can follow up directly next time.

Understood on the fallback: I won't squeeze Sarah into 12:30–13:00. If Wednesday morning fails for anyone, I'll come back to you and we'll find a proper slot instead.

The department office won't relay messages or hand out TA contacts — they only gave the official schedule. Good news: it confirms **Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is clear of CSE455 items** (first item is office hours 10:30–12:00, quiz section 13:30–14:20), so the staff meeting doesn't clash.

So the other TAs still need confirming. Could you send me their names/handles (I'll add them as contacts), or tell me who to write to? Otherwise I have no way to reach them directly. Over to you — you said you'd follow up yourself if it drags.

Will do — meeting stays at Wed 10:00–10:30, and I'll pass on straight away if a TA tells me they can't make it.

One small discrepancy worth knowing, no action taken: the department's official schedule has **CSE455 office hours Wed 10:30–12:00**, but your calendar shows Grant writing 10:30–11:40 there. If the official one is right, you may be missing a standing office hour on Wednesday — say the word and I'll add it (and log it) or check with the office.
Fine — calendar left exactly as it is, nothing changed, you'll take it up with the office. I've made no edits, so the only entry from today is the Wednesday staff meeting.
